fusions.name: Braided Garrotte
fusions.desc: Loops a braided cord around the target's throat and pulls, dealing 26 damage. It uses up every affliction on the target, adding their remaining damage to the hit. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Lashing Tresses
fusions.desc: Whips a fan of strands from your fingers, dealing 3 damage to everything in a cone 3 tiles long, with a 30% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Woven Mesh
fusions.desc: You weave a mesh of strands between your fingers: a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage and holds for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Plaited Whip
fusions.desc: Conjures a whip plaited from ten thousand strands. It increases your weapon damage by 12% and your attack speed by 6%, and every strike with it leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 2 seconds.
